abstractAssessment: Model combines photometry, radar and DART camera observations.

Along-track impulse estimate -2.63±0.06 mm/s; initial post-impact period11.377±0.004h, later11.3674±0.0004h, total reduction33.25min±1.5s. These are study-dependent orbital results, not spin or a current ephemeris.
Apsidal precession6.7±0.2deg/day depends on gravity modelling. Uniform-density triaxial inference gives a/b~1.3,a/c~1.6; this is not a resolved post-impact mesh.
Oblate-primary radii394±11m equatorial/290±16m polar refer to Didymos, never Dimorphos.
